seoTitle: Rent vs Buy Calculator: Wealth After N Years
metaDescription: Compare renting and investing with buying a home, including mortgage, upkeep, price growth, rent growth and selling costs.
intro: Estimates which path leaves you with more wealth after a number of years.
why:
The answer depends on assumptions you choose: price growth, rent growth, investment return and costs. The tool models both sides month by month and lets whoever pays less invest the difference.

It leaves out income tax on returns, mortgage interest relief and changing rates. Change a few inputs to see how sensitive the result is before deciding anything.
howTo: Enter price, down payment, rate and term.
Enter upkeep, growth, rent and investment return.
Choose the number of years and read the result.

faq.q: Why is upkeep a percent of value?
faq.a: It combines maintenance and property tax, which usually scale with value.
No. It is a model of your assumptions.
